I opened **[#83](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/pull/83)**. Each pi comment now ends with a collapsed section in place of the `🧵 Thread state` line, and `npm run check` passes.
🧵 This conversation is stored in git on refs/pi/threads/80 Read it from a clone of this repository ([more](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/main/docs/threads.md#read-a-thread)): ```bash git fetch origin 'refs/pi/threads/80:refs/pi/threads/80' git log --oneline refs/pi/threads/80 # one commit for each stored step git show refs/pi/threads/80:batch.json | jq . # the records of the newest step ```
- **Footer markup:** the `` goes inside ``, not around the whole `
`. When I checked your version with GitHub's Markdown API, GitHub dropped the outer `` and the line came out full size. - **Wording:** I used "This conversation is stored in git on ``" as the summary text, because it tells you what the section is before you open it. "View the session state" didn't say that. - **Job summary:** it now shows the commands only in `output` mode, where pi-action posts no comment. In `comment` mode the comment already has them, so the summary had nothing new. The `🧵 Thread` group in the workflow log still shows them in both modes. - **Code:** the footer is built in `src/formatting.ts`, and the job-summary condition is in `showThread()` in `src/run.ts`. - **Tests:** the new footer contains "one commit for each stored step", which broke the duplicate-reply check in `src/run.test.ts` (it searched comments for "one"). It now matches the start of the reply instead. - **Docs:** updated in `docs/how-it-works.md` (step 9) and `docs/threads.md` (Read a thread).
